info.name: Zubaan API
info.description: Zubaan English speaking coach API. Base URL is {{baseUrl}}. Public onboarding creates a user; all other API routes use x-user-id: {{userId}}. Errors are { error: { message } }. There is no application rate limit; provider limits may return 429. Use mock providers for free local testing.

request.description: Public health check. Auth: not required. Returns the health wrapper.

Creates a user and returns a recommended lesson. Auth: not required. Body: nativeLanguage (string, required, hi/ta/te/mr/bn/kn/ml/gu/pa/or); goal (string, required, daily_conversation/work/interviews/travel/confidence); level (string, required, beginner/elementary/intermediate/advanced); name (string, optional, trimmed, max 50 characters).
Auth: required via the x-user-id header, which must be a real MongoDB ObjectId belonging to an onboarded user.

Auth: required via the x-user-id header, which must be a real MongoDB ObjectId belonging to an onboarded user. Query: category (optional, daily/work/career/travel) and level (optional, beginner/elementary/intermediate/advanced).

exec: pm.test('Response is an array', function () { pm.expect(data).to.be.an('array'); });

response.body:

request.description: Auth: required via the x-user-id header, which must be a real MongoDB ObjectId belonging to an onboarded user. Path id is a required trimmed string identifying a lesson.

exec: const words = data.stages?.find((stage) => stage.id === 'words'); const sentences = data.stages?.find((stage) => stage.id === 'sentences'); if (words?.exercises?.[0]?.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('exerciseId', words.exercises[0].id); if (sentences?.exercises?.[0]?.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('sentenceExerciseId', sentences.exercises[0].id);

response.name: Success

Body: exerciseId (string, required); result (string, required, correct/wrong/said/close/missed/skipped); answer (string or string[], optional; order-word arrays max 30 items of max 40 chars); retry (boolean, optional, defaults false).

COSTS MONEY unless the mock provider is on. Auth: required via the x-user-id header, which must be a real MongoDB ObjectId belonging to an onboarded user. Body: text (string, required, trimmed, 1-2500 chars); language (string, required, en-IN/hi-IN/ta-IN/te-IN); provider (string, optional, kokoro/sarvam); voice (string, optional, 1-120 chars); pace (number, optional, 0.5-2). Response is JSON metadata; audioUrl points to WAV audio.

COSTS MONEY unless the mock provider is on (STT_PROVIDER=sarvam still needs a provider key). Auth: required via the x-user-id header, which must be a real MongoDB ObjectId belonging to an onboarded user. Multipart fields: audio (file, required, supported audio MIME, max 10 MB); language (string, optional); provider (string, optional, sarvam); mode (string, optional, transcribe/verbatim/codemix/translit).

Auth: required via the x-user-id header, which must be a real MongoDB ObjectId belonging to an onboarded user. Query: type (optional mistake type); limit (optional integer 1-100); before (optional 24-hex cursor).
